blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Manila Regional Trial Court has issued an arrest warrant against gambling tycoon Charlie “Atong” Ang over the case of the missing “sabungeros” (cockfighting enthusiasts), the Department of Justice (DOJ) confirmed. In a statement on Tuesday, DOJ spokesperson Polo Martinez said the Manila RTC Branch 175 issued the arrest warrant against Ang, along with his co-accused former police officer Ryan Jay Orapa, for the crime of kidnapping and serious illegal detention last Oct. 30.
